coreMemory.english: v. to use time or money for something
coreMemory.structure: spend time doing /spend taɪm duɪŋ/（花时间做）；spend money on /spend mʌni ɑn/（在……上花钱）；spend the day with /spend ðə deɪ wɪð/（和……度过一天）；spend too much /spend tu mʌtʃ/（花费过多）
coreMemory.commonError: ❌ can to spend → ✅ can spend；❌ to spending → ✅ to spend

commonErrors.note: 情态动词 can 后直接接动词原形，不加 to。
不定式 to 后接动词原形；不要把不定式和 -ing 形式混合。
